invariants.rule: domain has no dependency on application, adapters or frameworks

application has no dependency on adapters or frameworks (only exception: org.springframework.stereotype.Service and org.springframework.transaction.annotation.* on use cases, see INV-12); domain has no framework at all
adapters do not reference each other
every external I/O interaction (db, http, queue, filesystem) is behind a port; clock/random ids in domain are WARN unless they prevent deterministic tests (see INV-13)
transport/persistence models never enter the domain
wiring only in composition root = bootstrap class (@SpringBootApplication) + component-scan; @Service/@Component on use cases and adapters is allowed wiring; no mandatory bootstrap package
use cases testable without real infrastructure

infrastructure exceptions (Spring Data, optimistic locking) translated at the outbound adapter; WARN if a single inbound point (ApiExceptionHandler) translates them and the project declares it as debt
domain<->persistence mapping is bijective; round-trip test per state/enum

no framework in domain; application has no Lombok/@Slf4j/@Autowired/web/persistence types; Java/Spring-only exception: @Service allowed on use cases; @Transactional only on methods writing to more than one port (INV-18)

domain owns identity and state transitions; domain should offer an overload taking the id (e.g. Order.create(UUID,...)) and receive time via Clock; adapters must not generate business ids or set the clock (all WARN unless they prevent deterministic tests)
every use case has at least one inbound adapter
domain/application errors translated in a single inbound handler, never default 500
persistence models named differently from domain models
sensitive data never stored or serialized in clear (toString, logs)
multi-port writes define a unit of work (@Transactional on that method is enough; decorator/TransactionTemplate optional, not default); rollback test required

naming.inbound: verb phrase in business language (e.g. RegisterAdopter)

forbidden_symbols_in_core: org.springframework (in domain: none; in application: only org.springframework.stereotype.Service and org.springframework.transaction.annotation.*)
org.slf4j (use a port or none in core)
